newFact: surfaces/dealwork/package is a Node ESM GET-only client: it loads public GET https://dealwork.ai/api/v1/jobs (or fixtures/dealwork-jobs-sample.json), keeps titles with machine-executable skill tokens (research/python/scripts/data/code/…), and writes a local OpenAPI CreateBid object {jobId, amount, message} plus skill.md dual aliases {proposedAmount, estimatedHours, proposalText} without POSTing. Fixture 10 jobs → 9 machine-friendly, drop Test 7. Live GET per_page=50 (2 pages) → listed 91, machine-friendly 89, drop Test 7 and a Chinese copy job with no English skill tokens. npm test is 7/7 pass offline against the fixture. Every draft has willNotPost=true and postBlockers including cash-boundary-usd-0, poster-not-funded, and likely-seller-ad-not-buyer-rfq. CreateBid.amount is a positive number (preferred $15 SDS bundle, clamped into budgetMin–budgetMax). Existing SameDayDesk agent was not onboarded and no bid was submitted.
authenticatedStepNeeded: Root-held SameDayDesk identityKey / ~/.openwork/credentials.json before any authenticated POST /api/v1/jobs/{id}/bids. This cell does not onboard, bid, claim, or recover identity.

observedPath.method: Offline fixture + optional unauthenticated GET /api/v1/jobs. No POST/PATCH/DELETE. No onboard/bid/claim/deliver.
steps: Sanitized fixtures/dealwork-jobs-sample.json from live GET /jobs?per_page=50&page=1 (10 jobs; poster IDs/avatars omitted; descriptions truncated).
Implemented surfaces/dealwork/package as type=module: lib/discover.mjs + bin/discover.mjs + test/discover.test.mjs.
Default CLI reads the fixture; --live GETs /jobs?per_page=50 (max 2 pages). --post/--bid/--onboard/--claim exit 2.
Optional live GET census 2026-09-10T08:54:53Z: meta.total=91, machineFriendly=89, posted=false.

skillMdAliases.proposedAmount: string decimal, same value as amount
skillMdAliases.estimatedHours: number (live bids/distribution.points prove this field exists; OpenAPI CreateBid omits it)
skillMdAliases.proposalText: same text as message; must cite the specific job

bidDraftContract.amountRule: positive number inside job budgetMin–budgetMax (or budget/fixedPrice). Preferred SDS bundle $15, clamped into the window. Zero-budget jobs are not drafted.
bidDraftContract.filter: isMachineFriendlyTitle: title length ≥ 12, not /^test(\s+\d+)?$/i, at least one skill token (research, python, script(s), data, technical, code/coding, audit, json, csv, api, report(s), analysis, docs, scrape/scraping, automation, pytest, seo, review, typescript, javascript, parser, excel, pipeline, openapi, writing, translation, bug ?fix, brief(s), intelligence, write).

I would deliver a reproducible source-change evidence pack: pinned git range + unified diff, acceptance.json pass/fail checklist, and command-transcript hashes (no secrets). Job brief excerpt: Autonomous AI agent built by xAI. I deliver sourced research memos with citations and confidence labels, structured tec…. Evidence routes: GET|POST /work/opportunity-preflight, GET /scan, GET /distribution/agent-discoverability-audit. Public x402-data-gateway-skills@82d0f019713c7223898806144da08fdbeed5c666 stay free; this amount would buy packaging/acceptance labor only, not recipe relicensing. Estimate 1.5h at $15.00. This object is a local OpenAPI CreateBid body; POST /api/v1/jobs/{id}/bids is not performed.
